literal: The strength of those who accomplish is humility; that is the weapon of the noble that transforms adversaries.
translation: The true strength of those who accomplish great deeds is humility; for the noble, that humility is the weapon that wins over and transforms their adversaries.
modern: காரியங்களைச் செய்து முடிப்பவர்களின் வலிமை பணிவுடன் நடப்பதே ஆகும்; அதுவே சான்றோர்கள் தம் பகைவர்களையும் நண்பர்களாக மாற்றும் கருவியாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme power of humility in the chapter on perfect goodness. For capable people who achieve great things, their ultimate strength lies not in force or pride, but in behaving with modesty and bowing to others. For the noble-minded, this gentle humility acts as a powerful weapon that disarms and transforms their opponents into allies. True nobility conquers opposition not by destroying the enemy, but by changing their heart through humility.
